name: Slack
shortDescription: Extracts browser session tokens from Chrome to enable full Slack workspace access including DMs, channels, message history, and search without requiring OAuth API keys.

rawRecord.short_description: Extracts browser session tokens from Chrome to enable full Slack workspace access including DMs, channels, message history, and search without requiring OAuth API keys.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive Slack workspace integration by extracting browser session tokens from Chrome rather than using official OAuth. Enables full read/write access to messages, channels, and direct messages. Features automatic token refresh, multi-layer credential storage (environment variables, local files, macOS Keychain), conversation exports with threading, message search across workspaces, and rate limiting with exponential backoff.
